name: io.github.midhunxavier/opcua
title: OPC UA MCP Server
description: MCP server for OPC UA: read, write, browse, call methods, history, events and alarms.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the OPC UA server to connect to, including any path the server expects. Read once at startup: one process serves one endpoint. Nothing verifies who answers at this address unless the server certificate is pinned.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SECURITY_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Encryption suite to negotiate for the secure channel. Anything other than None needs a client certificate and key. The two AES suites are Node-only: the Python runtime refuses them at startup rather than downgrading. None is unencrypted and unauthenticated, and keeps control tools blocked unless insecure control is explicitly allowed. An unknown policy stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SECURITY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Message security mode for the secure channel. Sign authenticates messages without encrypting them. A policy with mode None, or a mode without a policy, stops the server at startup; leaving it blank never downgrades a policy to signing only. Leave blank for SignAndEncrypt once a security policy is set, otherwise None.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_CLIENT_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Path to the certificate (PEM or DER) this client presents as its application identity. Required by any security policy other than None. A path that does not exist stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_CLIENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the private key matching the client certificate. A path, never key material. Whoever can read the file can impersonate this client: keep it readable only by the account running the server. A path that does not exist stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_APPLICATION_URI
environmentVariables.description: Application URI announced to the server. Set it only for a certificate that carries no URI of its own: a server may reject a session whose URI does not match the certificate. Leave blank for the subjectAltName URI of the client certificate.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SERVER_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Path to the OPC UA server's own certificate (PEM or DER), pinned: a server presenting any other certificate cannot complete the handshake. Control tools (writes, method calls, alarm actions) require it. Requires a security policy other than None. Unset, encryption protects against eavesdropping but not against an impostor endpoint, so control tools are refused unless OPCUA_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_SERVER_CONTROL is set. Set without a security policy, it stops the server at startup rather than pinning nothing; a pinned certificate that has expired or is not yet valid refuses to connect.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: OPC UA username. The session is anonymous when unset. Cannot be combined with a user certificate. Requires a password; either one alone stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the username. Without a security policy it crosses the network in clear text. Supply it through the client's secret storage, never on a command line.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_USER_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Path to the certificate identifying the user, for X.509 user authentication: a different key pair from the client certificate, which secures the channel. Requires the user key and a security policy other than None; cannot be combined with a username. Any of those combinations broken stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_USER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the private key for the user certificate. It signs the server's challenge and is never sent. Whoever can read the file can log in as this user: keep it readable only by the account running the server.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Which tools are offered. observe reads, browses, reads history and monitors; operator adds explicitly allowlisted writes, method calls and alarm actions; full exposes every tool and is meant only for a tightly scoped OPC UA account. Unset fails closed to observe; an unknown profile stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_POLICY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a version-1 JSON policy file, the only place per-node value bounds can be set. Every policy variable that is set overrides what the file says. An unreadable or invalid file stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOWED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool allowlist. It can only narrow the selected profile, never widen it. An unknown tool name stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOWED_WRITE_NODES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated exact node IDs the operator profile may write, as ns=2;i=5 or, stable across a server restart, nsu=<namespace-uri>;i=5. Setting it replaces the policy file's list, bounds included. Empty fails closed: operator can write nothing. A batch write with any target outside the list is refused before it reaches OPC UA.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOWED_METHODS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated object_node_id|method_node_id pairs the operator profile may call. Empty fails closed: operator can call nothing. An entry without | stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOW_ACKNOWLEDGE_ALARMS
environmentVariables.description: Let the operator profile act on alarms: acknowledge_alarm and every act_on_alarm action.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOW_INSECURE_CONTROL
environmentVariables.description: Permit control tools on an OPC UA channel with no security policy (None). Does not cover a secured channel to an unverified server; that is OPCUA_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_SERVER_CONTROL. Fail-open override: writes, method calls and alarm actions then travel unauthenticated and unencrypted. Reported as control=INSECURE-OVERRIDE in the startup line, get_server_status and every audit record. Never enable it against production equipment.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_SERVER_CONTROL
environmentVariables.description: Permit control tools on a secured OPC UA channel whose server certificate is not pinned with OPCUA_SERVER_CERT. Does not cover a channel with no security policy; that is OPCUA_ALLOW_INSECURE_CONTROL. Fail-open override: writes, method calls and alarm actions are then encrypted to whichever server answered the endpoint, which may be an impostor. Reported as control=UNVERIFIED-OVERRIDE in the startup line, get_server_status and every audit record. Never enable it against production equipment.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOW_OUT_OF_RANGE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Allow a write outside the EURange the OPC UA server itself published for the node. Fail-open override: it discards the only value bound a deployment with no policy file has.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_AUDIT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to an append-only file for the control audit trail, one JSON object per line, written beside stderr. Created if it does not exist. A file that cannot be opened stops the server rather than falling back to stderr alone.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_OPERATOR_ID
environmentVariables.description: Label stamped on every audit record, so a shipped log says which deployment a control call came from. A label, not a verified identity.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_RECONNECT_INITIAL_DELAY_MS
environmentVariables.description: Wait before the first attempt to repair a dropped or refused connection, in milliseconds. It doubles with each further attempt.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_RECONNECT_MAX_DELAY_MS
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling for the doubling retry delay, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_RECONNECT_MAX_RETRY
environmentVariables.description: Retries after the first attempt before a tool call gives up. 0 never retries; -1 retries forever.

environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Session lifetime asked of the OPC UA server, in milliseconds. It also sets the keep-alive period, so it decides how quickly an idle connection notices the server has gone.
